messages:
liam: Opening a tiny docs PR: add a concise function-calling example (price lookup) + a one-line JSON schema and two short SDK snippets (JS/Python). Need quick sanity check on links and wording.

neha: nice. please include an explicit fallback for when the tool returns null or errors, and a tiny eval case so QA can auto-run.

liam: draft flow: 
User: 'Get price for sku 555'
Assistant -> price_lookup(sku=555)
Tool returns: {"price_cents":1999,"currency":"USD"}
Assistant final (structured): {"price_display":"$19.99"}

carla: add this compact JSON Schema inline: {"type":"object","properties":{"price_cents":{"type":["integer","null"]},"currency":{"type":"string"}},"required":["currency"]} and one sentence noting price_cents may be null if the tool fails.

sam: SDK nit: show a one-line JS helper and a one-line Python validate call. Also avoid wording that implies our runtime enforces the schema  make it clear validation/parsing is on the client/docs side.

liam: JS example (docs): 
```js
const resp = await client.responses.create({model: 'x', input: prompt});
const parsed = Responses.parseStructured(resp); // docs helper: validates/normalizes
if (parsed.price_cents == null) { /* show fallback UI */ }
```
Python example (docs): 
```py
resp = client.responses.create(model='x', input=prompt)
parsed = validate_structured(resp)  # thin helper shown in docs
if parsed.get('price_cents') is None:
    # fallback path
```

neha: include eval case in PR body: prompt -> expected parsed {"price_display":"$19.99"}. Also use canonical internal links: docs/schema-best-practices and docs/tool-fallbacks.

docs-bot: docs-ci: "staging build started for PR #3402"

carla: quick wording note: change "guardrails enforce" -> "docs recommend validating". Otherwise LGTM.

liam: updated wording, added anchor entry so linkcheck passes, ran ./scripts/sanitize-snippets.sh locally. squashing into logical commits: example, schema, sdk-snippets, links.

docs-bot: docs-ci: "staging build passed (lint + linkcheck) for PR #3402"

neha: merging after CI. great small addition  follow-up ticket for extended runbook with error patterns and canonical shim functions.

liam: thanks all, will open the runbook follow-up next week.
